This books section presents authored work by Federica Gazzelloni on health metrics, infectious disease analytics, R programming, data science, and data visualization. It gives readers a structured path from the website's articles and tutorials into longer-form technical resources.

## Start with the book resources

- [Health Metrics and the Spread of Infectious Diseases](posts/hmsid/) for the main book hub.
- [The hidden math that shapes our health](posts/hmsid/posts/012026/) for an accessible introduction to DALYs, risk exposure, epidemic prediction, AI models, and spatial analysis.
- [Writing a book in R](posts/hmsid/posts/062025/) for the Quarto and R workflow behind the book.
